verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a free 'Lite' tier for a single user with 'essential smart time blocking features' (reclaim-docs-16/28) and separately describe a scheduling-links/booking-link feature (reclaim-docs-2/12/17/29), but no evidence explicitly states scheduling links are included in the free Lite tier rather than gated to paid plans. Missing for 10: explicit pricing-page confirmation that booking links are part of the free tier, and independent user confirmation of using booking links on the free plan.
